notes: High-resin calendula bred for herbalist use. Pick flowers daily through the season. Strong pollinator attractor.
harvestIndicators: Sticky orange-yellow blooms fully open at midday

seasonalTasks.title: Pinch calendula for bushier plants
seasonalTasks.body: Once the plants are several inches tall, pinch the growing tips so they branch and grow bushier.

seasonalTasks.title: Deadhead calendula
seasonalTasks.body: Remove spent flowers regularly to keep the plants blooming. Flowers left on may self-sow.
